note_en: fichas_completas.jsonl.gz = the ORIGINAL lines (byte for byte) of the 386 complete records; the 9 in fichas_excluidas.csv (warning: tier A with fewer than 3 verifiable links, or no strong identifier) do not enter. The P2/P3 CSV rows (3,773 without a record) are not part of this batch.
